name: Default Audit
description: Identify entrypoints and build a threat model, enumerate attack-surface hypotheses, construct code context, investigate security issues, verify false positives, and calibrate Finding severity.

turns.name: Entrypoint Analysis
prompt: Goal: Use the `tob-entry-point-analyzer` skill to identify every external, state-changing production entrypoint.
Constraints: Verify inheritance, access controls, and production reachability; cite exact paths and line numbers; exclude tests, mocks, examples, dead code, and read-only entrypoints.

turns.name: Threat Modeling
prompt: Goal: Read `./entry-points.md`, then use the `openai-security-threat-model` skill to build an evidence-based threat model that prioritizes the audit.

turns.name: Attack-Surface Hypotheses
prompt: Goal: Read `./entry-points.md` and `./threat-model.md`, and turn them into individually testable attack-surface hypotheses that guide the later audit stages.

turns.name: Context Building
prompt: Goal: Read `./entry-points.md`, then use the `tob-audit-context-building` skill to read the code line by line and build complete execution paths and architectural context for every entrypoint.

turns.name: Security Issue Analysis
prompt: Role: You are a senior security audit engineer.

Goal: Read `./entry-points.md`, `./threat-model.md`, `./attack-hypotheses.md`, and `./context.md`; test the attack hypotheses one by one, and investigate realistically triggerable security issues and compound attack chains along the execution paths.

turns.name: False Positive Check
prompt: Goal: Read `./findings.md` and `./context.md`, then use the `fp-check` skill to independently verify every candidate and eliminate false positives.
Output: Modify `./findings.md` in place, appending a `TRUE POSITIVE` or `FALSE POSITIVE` verdict with rationale to every `CAND-*`.

turns.name: Finding Severity Calibration
prompt: Goal: Read `./findings.md`, then use the `finding-format-skill` skill to merge duplicate TRUE POSITIVEs, calibrate severity, and produce the final report.
Output: Modify `./findings.md` in place with the calibrated final Findings, then submit them via `finding.submit-confirmed`.
